item.title: Brian Keith Purser, 52, of Magee, Mississippi - MageeNews.com
item.description: Brian Keith Purser Obituary Brian Keith Purser, 52, of Magee, MS, passed away on November 26, 2025. Born on May 20, 1973, Brian was known for his quick humor, class-clown personality, and his lifelong passion for music. A talented musician, he played in several bands over the years and enjoyed expressing himself through his music.
